segments.summary: Reviewed all sixteen settings and inspector inventory records. The concept-only owner gate is explicit, but the settings remain command-, state-, receipt-, test-, and accessibility-unbound.

Reviewed all fifteen observability, behavior, and audio/notification inventory records. Labels and defaults are present, while units, effects, delivery, failure, and verification contracts are absent.
Reviewed all fifteen concurrency and Git Operations inventory records. Anonymous limits and unwired destructive operations leave scheduling, authority, race, rollback, and oracle behavior undefined.
Reviewed all sixteen Git, execution, and context-injection inventory records. Enumerated choices lack governing state machines, lifecycle semantics, trust boundaries, and recovery behavior.

Reviewed all sixteen context, retrieval, permission, and Assistant Memory inventory records. Numeric limits, authority policy, consent, provenance, privacy lifecycle, and failure handling are not specified.

Reviewed all sixteen memory, global-default, provider/model, requested-versus-effective-model, and media inventory records. The visibility intent is preserved, but parameter, capability, fallback, and migration contracts are absent.

Reviewed all fifteen media, credential, budget/validation, and command-execution inventory records. Explicit disabled-state accessibility gaps, a toast-only API-key action, and unwired budget and execution controls remain critical seams.

Reviewed all sixteen command, file-access, advanced-security, and container inventory records. Fixture exclusion is explicit, while enforceable policy, portable discovery, authority, failure, recovery, and acceptance contracts are missing.
